title: Product Manager - Postgres
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We're hiring a Product Manager to own Postgres itself at Supabase. Every Supabase project is a full Postgres database, and Postgres is the foundation that Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions run on. You'll own the product experience of the database: Postgres versions and upgrades, maintenance, observability, extensions and security.
You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads Multigres https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws. You'll define the Postgres requirements that architecture must meet, and own how customers experience their database through that transition.
This role is ideal for someone who loves Postgres, sweats the details that make a database trustworthy, and is excited about improving the experience for millions of developers. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform.
WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
 - You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life. Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky.
 - You'll make maintenance predictable. You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected.
 - You'll help developers understand their database. Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix.
 - You'll own our extension ecosystem. Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions.
 - You'll own Postgres security. Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs.
 - You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call.
 - You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch.
 - You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers.
YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU
MUST HAVE
 - 4+ years of Product Management experience on databases, developer tools or infrastructure, or equivalent depth as an engineer, DBA or founder moving into product. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required.
 - Know Postgres well, or another relational database well enough to ramp quickly. You're comfortable reading EXPLAIN output and talking about replication, WAL, roles and extensions.
 - Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience. You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones.
 - Write clearly. Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion.
 - Build with what you own. You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use.
 - Use AI to move faster. You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls.
 - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.
STRONG SIGNAL
 - Worked on a managed database service.
 - Ran Postgres in production: upgrades, tuning, incident response.
 - Worked on database observability, performance tooling, or security and compliance products.
 - Contributed to Postgres, its extensions, or the wider open-source community.
 - Shipped something using Supabase.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Fully Remote
 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
 - ESOP
 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
 - Tech Allowance
 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
 - Health Benefits
 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
 - Annual Off-Sites
 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
 - Flexible Work
 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
 - Professional Development
 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
 - ~400 team members
 - 60+ countries
 - 20+ languages spoken
 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
 - 540,000+ community members
We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Product Manager, App o11y | Canada | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 
 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
 This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST.
 About Product Management: 
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
 Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. 
 The opportunity: 
 As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 
 Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.
 You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:
 Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
 Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
 Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities 
 Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers. 
 Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

 Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering
 What makes you a great fit: 
 A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
 5+ years of experience in Product Management
 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product 
 Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
 A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
 Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment

 HR-IT-Strategien : Mit deiner Kompetenz und deinem Verständnis der individuellen Kundensituation entwickelst du HR-IT-Systemarchitekturen unter Berücksichtigung von technischen, fachlich-organisatorischen und rechtlichen Abhängigkeiten. 
 Implementierung : Du kümmerst dich um die Beratung und Umsetzung von Kundenanforderungen zur Optimierung von HR-Prozessen und -Funktionalitäten in SAP HCM und H4S4. 
 Testmanagement : Du planst und begleitest Testings zur Sicherstellung der Systemqualität. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung von Schulungen Key-User und Anwender:innen.  
 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast dein Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Personalwirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen.   
 Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung als SAP HCM Berater:in mit und verfügst idealerweise über Erfahrungen in SAP HCM/ H4S4 sowie SuccessFactors Transformationen.  
 Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP HCM Modulen (z.B. Personaladministration, Zeitwirtschaft, Entgeltabrechnung) und bringst idealerweise bereits Expertise mit SAP-Basis, ABAP und Fiori sowie Integrationen mit.  
 Du hast Erfahrung in der Begleitung von strategischen HR-Projekten und Migrationsprojekten und verfügst dadurch bereits über sehr gute Projektmanagementfähigkeiten in klassischen und agilen Methoden.  
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.  
 Deine Benefits

Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

 Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Flexzeitkonto sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Eine teilweise Auszahlung einmal jährlich ist möglich. Die genauen Details besprechen wir gerne mit dir im persönlichen Gespräch. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 
 Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.
 Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. 
 Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Workforce Transformation Teams gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden die Arbeitswelt von morgen mit. Wir decken das ganze Spektrum der HR-Beratung ab, ganz gleich, ob es um Reward Consulting, die Auswahl und Implementierung von HR-Cloud-Lösungen oder um grundlegende Prozessveränderungen geht. title: Sr. Technical Program Manager (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
As the Technical Program Manager for AI Experiences, you’ll partner with product, design, and engineering teams building native AI experiences and agents so that customers meet one connected product, not a collection of separate features. You’ll map the journeys customers take across AI features, align teams on how those journeys should feel and behave, and make experience quality visible to design and product leadership through metrics and reporting.
You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to the Manager, Technical Program and Operations.
 You Will
 Drive experience continuity. Maintain a view of the end-to-end customer journeys that cross multiple AI features, such as starting a task with one agent and finishing it in another. Name a single accountable owner for each journey, set decision dates, and overlay team roadmaps without replacing them.
 Establish experience standards. Work with product and design to set shared interaction patterns and behaviors: how handoffs are presented, what context carries over, how agents identify themselves, how permissions are explained, and how errors are handled and recovered from. Publish them as guidance teams can apply.
 Center decisions on user value. Frame trade-offs in terms of customer outcomes. Review upcoming features against the agreed journeys, and raise gaps and inconsistencies before release.
 Drive cross-team decisions to closure. Sequence product, UX, research, engineering inputs, and run working sessions with named owners and dated action items.
 Report on an experience scorecard. Define metrics that capture task completion across features, drop-off at handoffs, consistency results, customer trust and satisfaction, and time to value. You’ll set baselines and targets, secure instrumentation with analytics and research partners, and bring the results into reporting. 
 Reduce fragmentation. Identify places where similar tasks behave or read differently across features, and drive alignment plans that you track across teams.
 Bring customer evidence into planning. Work with UXR, support, and customer success to turn feedback and usage data into a prioritized list of continuity issues.
 Partner with the platform program. Translate journey requirements into component needs with the TPM, AI Platform. Agree on a shared view of sequencing and dependencies, and avoid duplicating each other’s work.
 Communicate clearly. Write decision-first and outcome-first updates tailored to leaders and project stakeholders
 You Have
 2-4 years of program or product management experience on cross-functional programs that span product, design, and engineering teams across multiple timezones.
 Experience working closely with UX and design, and using research and customer feedback to shape decisions. You can read a user journey and spot where it breaks.
 Working knowledge of AI agent experiences as customers see them: conversational interfaces, agent handoff, context and memory, transparency, trust, and error recovery.
 Experience defining experience or product-quality metrics: baselines, targets, instrumentation, and adoption or satisfaction measures.
 Proven ability to lead without authority across product, UX, engineering, and research.
 Strong planning discipline: dependency mapping, risk tracking, and capacity awareness.
 Excellent written communication, especially decision memos and executive reporting.
 Legal eligibility to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.
 Fluency in English is required.
 Nice To Have
 Experience with design systems or pattern libraries across many teams.
 Familiarity with journey mapping, service blueprints, and usability testing.
 Familiarity with responsible AI for users – i.e., disclosure, consent, and explainability.
 Experience with Jira, Confluence, Figma, and work-management tools at scale.

 At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role.
